items.headline: Anthropic Raises $5B Series E at $60B Valuation
items.summary: Anthropic has closed a $5 billion Series E round led by Google and Spark Capital, valuing the AI safety company at $60 billion. The round follows rapid enterprise adoption of Claude. For early employees like #47, this marks the third major valuation step-up since joining.

items.headline: AI Safety Regulation Bill Advances in Senate
items.summary: A bipartisan Senate bill requiring frontier AI labs to conduct independent safety evaluations before deployment advanced out of committee. Could impact Anthropic operations and compliance costs.

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Achieves Record Enterprise Adoption
items.summary: Anthropic reports Claude is now used by 60% of Fortune 500 companies, up from 35% a year ago. Enterprise ARR exceeded $1.5B in Q4 2025.

items.headline: AI Startup Employee Stock Liquidity Improves as Secondary Markets Grow
items.summary: Secondary market platforms report record volume in AI company shares, with Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI among the most traded. Employees gain more options for pre-IPO liquidity.

items.headline: SF Rents Stabilize After Two Years of Decline
items.summary: San Francisco rental prices have plateaued, with 1BR median rents at $3,700-$3,900. Hayes Valley and Mission remain the most competitive neighborhoods.

items.headline: NVIDIA Set to Report Q4 Earnings Amid AI Spending Boom
items.summary: Analysts expect NVIDIA to post record revenue of $38.5B, driven by surging demand for AI training chips from hyperscalers including Anthropic.

items.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Compete for Enterprise AI Market
items.summary: The two leading AI labs are in a fierce competition for enterprise contracts, with Anthropic winning on safety reputation and OpenAI on brand recognition.

items.headline: Fed Officials Signal Patience on Rate Cuts Amid Sticky Inflation
items.summary: Federal Reserve governors emphasized data dependency, suggesting rate cuts may be delayed until clear evidence of inflation returning to target.

items.headline: Bitcoin Falls Below $98K as Crypto Market Faces Profit-Taking
items.summary: Major cryptocurrencies declined overnight as traders locked in gains. BTC dropped 3.2% while ETH fell 1.8%.

items.headline: SafeGuard AI Accepted to Y Combinator W26 Batch
items.summary: SafeGuard AI, an AI safety startup founded by ex-Google DeepMind researchers, was accepted into Y Combinator Winter 2026. The company is commercializing alignment evaluation tools.

items.headline: Private Company Employees Face Tax Complexity from Stock Options
items.summary: As AI startups reach massive valuations, early employees confront AMT exposure, ISO exercise timing, and multi-year tax planning challenges. Experts recommend spreading exercises over 3-5 years.

items.headline: AI Lab Compensation Arms Race Continues
items.summary: Top AI researchers command $1M+ total compensation packages as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Meta AI compete for talent. Staff-level researchers see the largest increases.

items.headline: IRS Increases FBAR Enforcement Against US-Based Foreign Account Holders
items.summary: The IRS announced expanded enforcement of FBAR and FATCA obligations for US taxpayers with foreign financial accounts. Penalties for non-willful violations increased to $16,117 per account per year. British expats in the US with UK pensions, ISAs, and bank accounts are particularly affected.

items.headline: UK Workplace Pension Reporting Requirements Tighten for US Expats
items.summary: US tax practitioners warn that HMRC and IRS data sharing under FATCA is catching more British citizens abroad who fail to report UK pensions as foreign trusts. Form 3520 penalties can reach 35% of pension value. Cross-border tax specialists recommend proactive disclosure.

items.headline: Anthropic Valued at $60B in New Funding Round
items.summary: Anthropic closed a $3B funding round at a $60B valuation, led by Google and Spark Capital. The round values employee shares significantly higher than prior tenders.

items.headline: AI Startups Face Scrutiny on Employee Stock Liquidity
items.summary: With IPO markets still sluggish, AI companies face pressure to offer more frequent tender offers. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Databricks all held secondary sales in 2025.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates at 4.75% — Two Cuts Expected in 2026
items.summary: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged at its December meeting, signaling two 25bp cuts in the first half of 2026 as inflation moderates.

items.headline: UK Pension Transfers to US Face New HMRC Scrutiny
items.summary: HMRC announced tighter oversight of QROPS transfers, affecting UK expats considering moving pension assets to US-based retirement accounts.

items.headline: NVIDIA Q3 Earnings Crush Estimates — Revenue Hits $35B
items.summary: NVIDIA reported Q3 revenue of $35B, up 94% YoY. Data center segment drove 87% of revenue as AI training demand shows no signs of slowing.

items.headline: Bitcoin Breaks $90K as Institutional Adoption Accelerates
items.summary: Bitcoin hit $90K for the first time, driven by $2.1B in spot ETF inflows. Institutional allocations to crypto increased 40% in 2025.

items.headline: IRS Issues Guidance on ISO AMT Credit Carryforward
items.summary: New IRS guidance clarifies AMT credit carryforward rules for incentive stock option exercises, potentially benefiting tech workers who exercised ISOs in 2024-2025.

items.headline: S&P 500 Finishes 2025 Up 22%, AI Stocks Lead
items.summary: The S&P 500 posted a 22% gain for 2025, marking back-to-back strong years. Magnificent Seven contributed over half of index returns.
